Name: Reorient After Eating
Author: PunningLinguist
Description:
If you've ever been fishing in a non-south direction and needed to restore your energy, you probably know how annoying it can get that the eating animation forcibly turns you to face south. This mod simply remembers what direction you were facing and reorients you to face the same way after the eating animation finishes.

[b][size=3]Prerequisites[/size][/b]
This mod requires the [url=https://smapi.io]Stardew Modding API[/url].

[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size][/b]
This mod was written for and tested on Stardew Valley 1.5. Multiplayer support is unknown.

[b][size=3]Known Issues[/size][/b]
None.

[b][size=3]Installation[/size][/b]
Extract this mod into your Mods subfolder of your Stardew Valley game folder.

[b][size=3]See Also[/size][/b]
Source code is available at [url=https://github.com/amconners/ReorientAfterEating]this mod's GitHub repository[/url]. This mod is licensed under the [url=https://github.com/amconners/ReorientAfterEating/blob/main/LICENSE]MIT License[/url].
